entry.title: Pyramid of the Sun

groundCutout.basis: Only the mapped occupied pyramid footprint replaces the existing terrain mound. Complete opaque floors and bounded foundation/excavation joins exist in every level;independent ruins and raw DEM are retained.

buildingCutout.basis: Single rectangular envelope of the principal pyramid and24 constituent terrace/platform controls,with10cm numerical allowance. Polygon intersection checks find no independent archaeological building inside it. Ground replacement remains bounded to the actual mapped occupied outline.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified161-square/6m normal Mapzen-USGS grid retained. Reference at native[-130,0] on the west approach setsY0 at2307.075m; the center sample2348.057m is the existing terrain mound and is deliberately not the model datum. Only the mapped occupied footprint is cut; a complete opaque floor and bounded excavation/foundation joins are present at every level. Coarse edge heights and the reconstructed65m summit are visualization fits,not surveyed elevations.

entry.note: Q29238/relation3373254 identifies the pyramid. Standard pinned PMTiles principal building52776561506502 and24 roof/platform parts define the225m main base, west projection, terrace edges and signed15.53-degree axis. The full parent outline including projections is236×222m. Reviewed approximate fit to the unchanged161-square/6m standard DEM. West-approach terrain reference replaces the existing central mound rather than stacking the model above it. All four levels close the occupied-footprint cutout;25 pyramid/terrace records are replaced and86 independent tile buildings are preserved exactly. Failed loading retains all111 records and the original terrain mound. Eviction restores ground and disposes all model geometry. Partial128m residency retains terrain outside its loaded domain;the empty-semantic partial fixture proves clipping/lifecycle only,not full-site contact at temporary boundaries. Partial-boundary gaps remain an explicit renderer limitation. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
